title: Self-Pay Booking Deposit Terms, In-Person Appointments
content:
A booking deposit on In-Person Appointments is money collected from a self-pay patient for one scheduled visit and held until the visit is completed (applied to its charges), cancelled on time (refunded) or missed or cancelled late (forfeited toward the fee).

**Term 1, collection.** The sentence *"When the patient's billing account is on the Self-Pay Account tier on the booking date, the visit type's self-pay booking deposit is collected when the visit is booked (none where it is 0.00)."* is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis. The visit type's self-pay booking deposit figures remain those of the schedule of deposits.

**Term 2, number of deposits.** The sentence *"One deposit is collected per appointment."* is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**Term 3, holding and release.** The deposit is held on the appointment until the visit closes. On completion it is applied in full to the visit's charges. On a timely or clinic-initiated cancellation it is refunded in full within the visit type's refund period in business days. The remainder of this term, *"on a no-show or late cancellation it is forfeited toward the fee that is actually charged, and any part above that fee (or the whole deposit when the fee is waived) is refunded"* (the part forfeited being the lesser of the deposit held and the fee), is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**Term 4, reschedules.** The sentence *"A reschedule carries the deposit to the new slot."* is **no longer in force** and has been superseded by the current basis.

**Term 5, insurance gained before the visit.** A patient who gains insurance before the visit keeps the deposit on the appointment until the visit closes.

### How a held deposit ends, under the terms in force

| How the visit closes | What happens to the deposit held |
|---|---|
| Completed | Applied in full to the visit's charges |
| Cancelled with timing timely | Refunded in full within the refund period |
| Cancelled by the clinic | Refunded in full within the refund period |

*Hypothetical:* a self-pay patient holding a deposit on an Annual Preventive Exam becomes insured two weeks before the visit; the deposit stays on the appointment and, when the visit is completed, is applied in full to its charges.

superseded_clauses: on a no-show or late cancellation it is forfeited toward the fee that is actually charged, and any part above that fee (or the whole deposit when the fee is waived) is refunded.
